To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method of gene therapy for cancer that uses a recombinant virus to deliver a ribozyme that specifically targets the mutant H-ras gene.

a recombinant virus was designed to deliver the H-ras hammerhead ribozymes to tumor cells and that the ribozyme mediated the reversion of the transformed phenotype in tumor cells without the requirement of any selection steps.
adenoviral-mediated ribozymes have the potential to become a useful therapeutic tool.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of strategies to accomplish the targeted eradication of neoplastic cells by the use of ribozymes.
the development of novel approaches to cancer gene therapy.
the application of gene therapy strategies to the treatment of human cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have demonstrated the utility of adenaviral-mediated delivery of a ribozyme designed for cleavage of mutant H-ras transcripts.
the use of adenoviruses as vectors for gene therapy is a viable and promising approach to the treatment of neoplastic disease.

the use of adenoviral vectors to accomplish the efficient delivery of anticancer genes, such as ribozymes, to target neoplasms will allow the practical use of gene therapy strategies for the eradication of cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the utility of ribozymes to accomplish tumor eradication and have developed an efficient method to deliver ribozymes to tumors.
we have demonstrated that the adenoviral delivery of the H-ras hammerhead ribozymes to the H-ras transformed NIH3T3 cell line can revert the neoplastic properties of these cells.
the adenoviral-mediated expression of an H-ras ribzyme is able to reverse the neoplastic phenotypes of H-ras oncogenic tumor cells in vitro and in vivo.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the delivery of ribozymes to tumors by recombinant adenoviiral vectors is a practical means to accomplish targeted cancer therapy.

the use of an anti-rat oncogene ribozyme can be used to revert the malignant phenotype of neoplastic cells, and that this can be accomplished by using a high-efficiency recombinant adenoviiral vector to accomplish delivery of the ribzyme.
it is possible to accomplish neoplastic reversion by using an anticancer ribozyme delivered by a high efficiency recombinant adenocarrier.
